abilities.name: Sanctifying Ring

_curatorNotes: tickCap 8 / 10 at C2, MIRRORING the damage series on this summon (tick-cap round, 2026-08-18): gcsim skill.go `bellTick` queues the attack AND calls Player.Heal in the same task before rescheduling itself, so the heal and the damage are one tick. Verified in source rather than inferred - the oracle cannot see a heal at all, since a heal tick leaves no damage event.

tickCap 8 / 10 at C2 (tick-cap round, 2026-08-18): gcsim skill.go `skilldur := 720` (900 at C2) with bellTick self-rescheduling every 90f while the ring status is live, so the tick landing on the window boundary fires. Measured 8 at C0 and 10 at C6; our duration-derived counts were 7 and 9. The C2 override is required, not decorative - a flat cap would freeze the constellation at 8.

Ring periodic heal authored 2026-07-12 as a summonTick heal on the Grass Ring summon (Linnea Memo Heal Aura / Jahoda Robot shape). gcsim skill.go: tick every 90f (1.5s), first tick 90f after ring activation at frame 23 (= spawnsAt) — matches the summonTick firstTickDelay default, so it's omitted. Heal targets c.Core.Player.Active() → target 'active'. TL10: skillhealpp[9]=0.054 (5.4% Max HP) + skillhealflat[9]=635.608 (sidecar '5.4% Max HP+636').

A4 Heart's Repose heal boost (+75% of Shinobu's EM per tick, gcsim a4Healing) co-located on the ring heal via flatScaling per the Aino A4 precedent (DEFAULT_ASCENSION=4 ⇒ A4 active). The manual-trigger stub effects on the Heart's Repose passive node are retained as documentation and do not dispatch.

Ring electro DMG tick authored 2026-07-12 as a summonTick damage effect alongside the heal (Diona Drunken Mist heal+damage pair shape). Same bellTick pulse: gcsim skill.go bellTick queues both the QueueAttack and the Heal every 90f (1.5s), so trigger is identical to the heal's (firstTickDelay omitted = interval default). TL10: skilldot[9]=0.45432 → 45.43% ATK (sidecar 'Grass Ring of Sanctification DMG' col 10 = 45.4%), electro, ICDTag ElementalArt. A4 DMG boost (+25% of Shinobu's EM flat per tick, gcsim a4Damage) co-located via flatScaling, mirroring the heal's A4 treatment (DEFAULT_ASCENSION=4 ⇒ A4 active).
abilities.description:
Creates a Grass Ring of Sanctification at the cost of part of her HP, dealing Electro DMG to nearby opponents.

Grass Ring of Sanctification
Follows your current active character around. Deals Electro DMG to nearby opponents every 1.5s and restores HP for active character(s) within the ring's AoE based on Kuki Shinobu's Max HP.

The HP consumption from using this skill can only bring her to 20% HP.

abilities.name: Gyoei Narukami Kariyama Rite

_curatorNotes: gcsim internal/characters/kuki/burst.go, func Burst(): the field queues QueueAttackWithSnap on a fixed loop `for i := burstStart; i < count*interval+burstStart; i += interval` with const burstStart = 50, interval := 2 * 60 / 7 = 17 frames (integer division), count = 7. So ticks land at cast-relative frames 50,67,84,…,152. interval = 17/60 = 0.283s; firstTickDelay = (50 − spawnsAt 50)/60 = 0. Matches the measured row in docs/curation/gcsim-frames-diff.md §5 (50f / 17f × 7).

Scaling: the tick's AttackInfo has Mult: 0 and FlatDmg: c.MaxHP() * burst[c.TalentLvlBurst()] — it is a pure Max-HP-scaling hit, hence stat 'hp'. burst[9] (talent level 10, 0-based) = 0.064886 in zz_kukishinobu.dm.go (comment: 'burst: GyoeiNarukamiKariyamaRite - Single Instance DMG: {0} Max HP'), stored as percentage points 6.4886. Cross-check: talent sidecar row 'Single Instance DMG' 10th value = '6.5% Max HP'.

Element/ICD: AttackInfo Element: attributes.Electro, Durability: 25 (1U), ICDTag: ICDTagElementalBurst + ICDGroup: ICDGroupDefault — standard ICD, and the measured row's verdict is 3/7 'standard', so no icdGate is annotated.

Tick COUNT is HP-conditional, not constellation-conditional: gcsim sets count = 12 when CurrentHPRatio() <= 0.5 (comment says 'can be 11 at low HP'; the code says 12), which is why the sidecar 'Duration' row reads 2.0s/3.5s. The C0/high-HP series (7 ticks over the authored 2s duration) is what is authored; the low-HP extension has no schema expression (HP is not a Condition subject) and the existing duration of 2 is left untouched. C1 only widens the AoE radius (r 4.0 → 6) and changes neither cadence nor count.

tickCap 7 (tick-cap round, 2026-08-18): gcsim burst.go declares `count := 7` outright (12 below 50% HP, which we do not model and which is already noted). Our duration-derived 8 was one long. Unchanged at C6.

HP-conditional duration: gcsim uses count=7 ticks (base, ~2s) or count=12 ticks (when HP ≤50%, ~4s from cast), interval=17 frames, burstStart=50. HP condition is not supported by durationModifiers schema (constellation-only). Reviewer to decide representation. gcsim comment notes '11 at low HP' but code sets 12.

Field tick damage authored 2026-08-17 as a summonTick damage effect on the Gyoei Narukami Kariyama Rite summon (see that effect's own notes). The cast itself lands no hit — application[] stays the empty positive statement; every hit belongs to the field.
nonHitting (non-hitting casts round, 2026-09-16 (docs/nonhitting-casts-round.md §1)): gcsim kuki/burst.go:52-58 enumerates the seven ticks from f50 inside Burst() — the summon series.
abilities.description:
Stabs an evil-excoriating blade into the ground, creating a field that cleanses the area of all that is foul, dealing continuous Electro DMG to opponents within its AoE based on Shinobu's Max HP.

passives.name: Heart's Repose
_curatorNotes: Inherited manual triggers on both effects — actual trigger is onCast (skill), boosting the ring's periodic heal and DMG based on Shinobu's EM for the ring's duration. Reviewer to update triggers and confirm durationType.

↻ 2026-09-21 (manual-trigger retirement, docs/manual-trigger-retirement-round.md). Both effects resolved. The DAMAGE half CONVERTED to the flat-DMG house form: gcsim `asc.go:41-46` returns `EM × 0.25` and it lands as `FlatDmg` on both the ring tick (`skill.go:120`) and the skill's own cast hit (`skill.go:58`). ⚓ `skillFlatDmg` is EXACT rather than approximate — Sanctifying Ring is her only skill, so the class and the ability coincide, and her burst's Max-HP ticks take neither half. ⚠️ It was a DOUBLE STATEMENT: the same bonus was also folded into the ring's damage tick as `flatScaling {em, 25}`, removed in the same edit so the claim lives in one place, and the chip is the place with a pixel. The HEAL half was RETIRED: there is no heal-side buff stat for a flat add-on, and the bonus is already authored where it lands, as `flatScaling {em, 75}` on the ring's heal tick (the Kachina-A4 shape) — ⛔ that one stays folded. ⚠️ Its authored `target: "self"` was wrong besides; the ring heals the ACTIVE character (gcsim `Target: Core.Player.Active()`).

constellations.name: To Sever Sealing
_curatorNotes: Inherited manual trigger — actual trigger is onHit (when ring-affected active character hits enemies with Normal/Charged/Plunging Attack, once per 5s ICD). gcsim has TODO comment about frames and ICD tag. Reviewer to update trigger and confirm ICD.

↻ 2026-09-21 (manual-trigger retirement, docs/manual-trigger-retirement-round.md). C4: To Sever Sealing — effects[0] (damage hp 9.7, electro) RE-TRIGGERED and RE-HOMED onto the skill's summon. ⚓ A proc is armed by the CAST that hosts it: `armCastProcs` (`sim/run.ts`) is handed `variant?.effects ?? active.effects` and never sees a constellation entry, so an effect authored here would be armed by nothing. The constellation gate travels with the effect's own `conditions` instead (the Faruzan C6 precedent). gcsim: `~/Code/gcsim/internal/characters/kuki/cons.go:19-57` — `c4` is an `OnEnemyDamage` hook: 300-frame (`5s`) ICD status; tag must be `AttackTagNormal`/`Extra`/`Plunge`; `ae.Info.ActorIndex` must equal `Core.Player.Active()`; `Status.Duration(ringKey)` must be non-zero; then a Thundergrass Mark — Electro, Durability 25, `ICDTagNone`, `FlatDmg: MaxHP × 0.097`, queued at 5 frames. The C4 entry's `_curatorNotes` must say the mark is authored as an `onHit` proc on the Grass Ring's summon effects, not here — a summon-hosted proc is armed by the summon's own liveness, which is precisely gcsim's `ringKey` check, and it inherits the C2 `+3s` duration modifier for free where a hardcoded `armedFor` could not. It carries its own constellation condition because a summon effect is not gated by the constellation entry. Record `icdGate: 'none'` = `ICDTagNone`, `application[0].frame: 5` = the queue delay, Durability 25 = 1U, and drop the inherited "gcsim has TODO comment… reviewer to confirm ICD" line (the 5s is stated by the kit and by `AddStatus(c4IcdKey, 300)` alike). ⚠️ ⛔ No `armedFor` — lint B.13b refuses one on a summon-hosted proc. `source: 'active'` refuses entity-delivered hits, which is right (gcsim tests `ActorIndex == Active()`) and costs nothing, since no summon deals normal/charged/plunge damage. ⚠️ The proc draws a MARK on the Grass Ring's lane, beside its eight 1.5s tick markers, at C4+ — defensible (the ring on the active character is literally what makes the mark land) but it is a visible change and worth Nate's eye. ⚠️ A listener never fires off its own output, so the mark cannot chain.
constellations.description:
When the Normal, Charged, or Plunging Attacks of the character affected by Shinobu's Grass Ring of Sanctification hit opponents, a Thundergrass Mark will land on the opponent's position and deal AoE Electro DMG based on 9.7% of Shinobu's Max HP.
This effect can occur once every 5s.

constellations.name: To Ward Weakness
_curatorNotes: Actual trigger is HP-drop-below-25% with a 60s ICD (gcsim onDrain). HP-state conditions aren't modelled in the planner — manual trigger preserved per the HP-state-null-resolving convention.

↻ 2026-09-21 (manual-trigger retirement, docs/manual-trigger-retirement-round.md). C6: To Ward Weakness — effects[0] (buff em 150) RE-TRIGGERED. gcsim: `~/Code/gcsim/internal/characters/kuki/cons.go:63-93` — `c6` subscribes to `OnPlayerHPDrain`: returns unless `CurrentHPRatio() <= 0.25`, revives to 1 HP at or below zero, sets a 3600-frame (60s) ICD, then a 900-frame (15s) `+150 EM` StatMod. the HP-state-null-resolving convention but stop citing `manual` as its expression: the house form is `passive` + `selfHpBelow`, the Kaeya C4 "Frozen Kiss" precedent (`passive` + `selfHpBelow: 20` + `duration: 20`, 60s ICD unenforced). It must also retain that the lethal-DMG survival half of the constellation is unmodelled and lives in the `description` alone. ⚠️ The always-on chip prints +150 EM with no ICD and no window — a large number stated unconditionally, which is why the caveat carries both the gate and the cadence. ⛔ `onHPDecrease` is the literal trigger and has no reader; it must not be proposed. ⚠️ `duration`/`durationType` are inert under a `passive` trigger (Kaeya's precedent carries `duration` alone); they are kept because they are already there and they document the 15s, not because anything reads them.
constellations.description:
When Kuki Shinobu takes lethal DMG, this instance of DMG will not take her down. This effect will automatically trigger when her HP reaches 1 and will trigger once every 60s.
When Shinobu's HP drops below 25%, she will gain 150 Elemental Mastery for 15s. This effect will trigger once every 60s.
constellations.caveat: Only while Shinobu is below 25% HP, for 15s and once a minute — the chip prints it as though it were always on.
